title: Urine LF-LAM
dek: A lateral-flow antigen test for lipoarabinomannan in urine. It earns its keep in advanced HIV and the seriously ill — not as a community screen of CD4-high outpatients.
story: Lipoarabinomannan is an envelope glycolipid. In disseminated/high-burden disease, especially with renal involvement or glomerular leak of mycobacterial products, LAM appears in urine. The Alere Determine TB LAM Ag strip is the WHO-endorsed LF-LAM assay with a specific use case: people with HIV who are seriously ill, or who have advanced HIV disease, with or without TB symptoms depending on the exact recommendation stratum.

Sensitivity is a function of CD4 and burden. It is modest in CD4 > 200 outpatients and much more useful as CD4 falls or as inpatients get sicker. Specificity is generally high but not perfect (NTM, contamination, reader error on a faint band).

LF-LAM does not replace mWRDs, does not grade rifampin, and does not diagnose LTBI. Next-generation LAM (e.g. FujiLAM) aims at better Se; until WHO says otherwise, programme SOP follows the endorsed strip and strata.
deepTitle: Likelihood ratios with CD4 in the denominator
deep: A positive LAM in an inpatient with CD4 20 is a treat-now result while you still chase sputum/stool/CSF WRDs and DST.
A negative LAM does not rule out TB at any CD4.
Do not run LF-LAM on HIV-negative community volunteers because you bought a box of strips.
Pediatric use tracks HIV/advanced disease guidance, not a universal child screen.

example.title: Faint band, CD4 18, Xpert not detected on one sputum
example.setup: Inpatient, WHO danger signs, urine LAM faint-positive by two readers, single sputum Ultra not detected.

steps.title: One sputum is not a rule-out
steps.body: Advanced HIV, seriously ill: extra-pulmonary and paucibacillary sputum are expected.

steps.title: Treat
steps.body: WHO: LAM+ in this stratum supports starting TB therapy while you keep sampling.

steps.title: Still hunt DST
steps.body: Blood culture, additional sputa, stool, tNGS if available. LAM is not rpoB.

example.takeaway: LF-LAM is a stratum-specific antigen test, not a cartridge.
